'''Burnok''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] and good friend of the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Oren Ward]]. During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], the pair were on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]] where Oren attempted to sneak into the [[Fa'athra's Palace|palace]] of the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Voontara Fa'athra]] to steal treasure from the criminal. The Mandalorian was caught, however, and frozen in [[Carbonite/Legends|carbonite]] as punishment by Fa'athra. Burnok then hired a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] in the industrial [[City/Legends|town]] of [[Jiguuna]] to rescue his companion.
